data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=T-8m1ka3dp4Q7kNvgGT9zT_&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCNFULoFtn8TR8CapGHRS0pYTf-LAryVWVAyv8VrtGHhw&oe=675D6C9C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_X95h914QnkQ7kNvgFxdcu3&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCGC3Yd_7ICVHGLMeufARNjSrCEU4BC0JYUqvezL0ZlWg&oe=675D7624)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=DtKIDfxCO6gQ7kNvgHeA2E8&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB-9qGsFlx_uTXIHUipzBlWUdWlnES2AnYT8Va7dasvlw&oe=675D5D87)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=N7TYZ8QDqjsQ7kNvgFGAfTQ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBN8s4DkWmHbnBLMZYdKceKuCttumavmEoTmWgeq4UJqQ&oe=675D5066)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=tO0HHy4vZcIQ7kNvgGsnIIo&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBCZ06z78jq7FdFn9YNkYDduitHccdaV0xNgECMXbmRpA&oe=675D7CD8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=6CWXGVQl5UEQ7kNvgH8FeYb&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDY6kSuH_OL--sl_RAo4g8JNdvA_qxL2WZRUPXl0x99BQ&oe=675D7959)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=oCXjTmTzfFwQ7kNvgHEX8Z1&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC5eEHExQSNv7F23gkMyRtSRJdI6AaN7u1ih4Bd_6JN_w&oe=675D5F70)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Kat4xLb0ePkQ7kNvgFTDPIi&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBMRQRyieXz7tnICBapdItyigvnZY_og7vbWRXtZS-5Sg&oe=675D822A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=bKjUrQbHcdoQ7kNvgFC_PIT&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD1Ji4N5NlzeMmoRZc6fixou2SGuCBuI-gvWc8UkD_WGA&oe=675D5D97)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=54Na70NBwMUQ7kNvgFJ9byT&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDXpASc3Pozj1BiFLH-tVuc0Q2JOdc2uANCKsMMQGJB3Q&oe=675D790C)
